subject: Superintendent Evaluation Composite Review
overview: The subcommittee met to compile individual school committee member ratings into a composite draft for the Superintendent's 2022-23 performance evaluation. The body reviewed quantitative data indicating a proficient rating and established a timeline to finalize narrative comments.

items.title: Compilation of Composite Evaluation Ratings
items.summary: The subcommittee reviewed a draft composite of numerical ratings from individual member evaluations, which showed a consensus of proficient performance across professional practice, student learning, and district improvement goals.

items.title: Public Comment on Evaluation Metrics
items.summary: In response to resident inquiries about community input and assessment standards, the committee clarified that the evaluation follows the state-mandated rubric and is based on evidence provided by the superintendent.

items.title: Process for Qualitative Narrative Selection
items.summary: The subcommittee agreed to create a summary slide explaining the evaluation metrics for the public and to select representative narrative comments at a follow-up meeting.

items.title: Continuation of Meeting
items.summary: The subcommittee voted to continue the meeting on June 1 to finalize the narrative portion of the composite evaluation.
